requirements.1_initialization_and_allocation: Actual new/zip and heap helper consumed. Empty std wrapper frame; exact source BumpAllocator arithmetic; source raw4 layout/capacity guards pinned and discharged numerically for n<=256. Full initializer success follows from start+8+8199+future<=cursor under the explicit 64-bit target ABI. No allocation-success/equivalence premise is supplied.
requirements.2_accumulation_and_callers: Whole actual coefficient/basis/accumulation/query/stage contexts consumed. Canonical rho/power/weights and length derive from actual preparation/constructor/resume sources; index/counter/coverage/overflow invariants established by source traversal and whole-call preservation.
requirements.3_source_transactions_and_observations: All three named actual transaction source bodies are inverse-factored at the proved stage; emitted bodies otherwise byte unchanged. Final source-consuming all_callers_equivalence plus fresh_source_equivalence, tx2_equivalence and tx2_authenticated_equivalence check. Query prefix invocation trace and arbitrary expanded ordered event trace check; exact source prefix has identical inputs and contains all query cryptographic calls. Same complete materialized state enters unchanged checkpoint and finish/settlement suffixes. Covered errors/divergence retained under sufficient logical resources.
requirements.4_pins_and_lean: Exact candidate/parent and frozen current source, producer repair pins, source fragments, coherent cache/import object identities, focused checks and final consuming bridge with complete axioms/metrics below.
requirements.5_publication: Side-branch commit/push remains a separate final publication check; no production Rust edited. No ELF/shared object/cache binary is part of this source proof.

boundary: Relative to the existing Rust/Aeneas primitive interpretation, compiler/producer and standard-library pointer ownership/Vec capacity/resize contracts. This is a source replacement proof, not a new machine-code/compiler or whole-Rust-stdlib correctness theorem.

The Raw4 empty-buffer reserve interpretation is justified by the pinned actual std call chain: cap=len=0; zero count no-op; checked add/mul and Layout guards admitted; current_memory=None; one Global.allocate call through the source bump allocator; cap assigned to count; resize within reserved capacity. No nonempty reserve/copy behavior is required.

The numeric condition is at the extra reservation boundary. future is a budget for unchanged remaining allocations and is preserved by the source bump bound. It is not an assertion that all 256 KiB are free or a universal fixture/input CU bound.
Inherited opaque core.fmt.Formatter is a Type used by the original Reader unwrap Debug argument; it is not a new propositional or candidate-equivalence axiom. No sorryAx appears in accepted targets.

Production features pool-adapter,private-leaf-salts, no prover. Prover-only intermediate trace canonicalization and arbitrary standalone convenience-helper consumers are outside these three selected release entrypoints. Both public None forwarding wrappers are inventoried without attributing a general helper theorem to them.

Actual trace::value calls are no-ops in the selected non-prover feature set. Transient raw coefficient representation is projected through the actual source finish; diagnostic logs are excluded from the protocol observation boundary. Phase callbacks and application effects follow the identical source contexts.
